data.name: Taking Root
data.description: Taking Root co-founded the CommuniTree Carbon Program with local NGO BOSNICA in 2010; it is a Plan Vivo-certified reforestation program that works with smallholder farmers in Nicaragua and has grown into the largest reforestation initiative in the country. The company has developed a management platform with a mobile app for field data collection and a web platform for program reporting to deliver high-integrity carbon removals. It has also launched biochar trials with partner PRIMAKLIMA, applying biochar in the CommuniTree program to improve soil health and store additional carbon.
